references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, instructions are given for the cleansing of the Levites, including sprinkling them with water of purification and shaving their entire body.
Aaron shall wave the Levites as a wave offering before the Lord's presence, which is also mentioned in verse 21.
Describes that the Levites are to serve at the tent of meeting after they have been cleansed and waved as a wave offering.
Deals with cleansing from impurity by purifying oneself on the third and seventh days.
Aaron makes atonement for the sanctuary because of the Israelites' impurity, parallel to how he makes atonement for the Levites.
The wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) is performed by Aaron and his sons before the Lord during the consecration of the priests.
The people are to wash their clothes as preparation to meet the Lord, corresponding to the washing of the Levites' clothes.
Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water as part of the priestly consecration.
The book of Hebrews compares the Old Testament cleansing rituals with Christ's blood that cleanses the conscience.
